question: Should Crabline continue supporting its current Node baseline with matching Node 22 declarations, or intentionally raise the supported runtime baseline before accepting Node 26 declarations?
rationale: The correct dependency version depends on the project’s supported-runtime contract; an automated repair cannot safely choose whether existing Node 22 users may lose support.

options.title: Retain the current runtime floor
options.body: Keep `@types/node` aligned with the existing minimum supported Node major and accept only a compatible maintenance update.

options.title: Raise the runtime baseline
options.body: Document and enforce a Node 26 minimum, then add upgrade evidence showing the new requirement is intentional.

recommendation.title: Retain the current runtime floor
recommendation.body: Keep `@types/node` aligned with the existing minimum supported Node major and accept only a compatible maintenance update.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-wide runtime-support decision rather than a change owned by the Dependabot branch.
